sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2025
sources.text: While underway, two perpetrators armed with knives were sighted at the accommodation deck. The master raised the general alarm and mustered all crew. The perpetrators escaped upon being discovered. The master conducted a search and found no sighting of the perpetrators. All crew were accounted for and with no injury. Nothing was stolen. Upon arrival in Singapore, the PCG boarded the ship to conduct investigation. No sighting of perpetrators.
